segments.name: Development and commercialization of therapeutics
segments.description: Biopharmaceutical company developing and commercializing life-changing therapies in oncology and rare diseases.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in a single reportable operating segment – the development and commercialization of therapeutics.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenues from product sales and license fees through direct commercialization and out-licensing agreements with collaborators.
revenueModel.evidence: In this regard, product sales relate to the Company's direct commercialization activities in the U.S. from October 2023 through November 2024, while license revenues relate to outlicensing agreements entered into in Asia and in the U.S. in October 2023 and November 2024, respectively.

changes.text: In October 2023, the company out-licensed rights to motixafortide for all indications in substantially all of Asia.
changes.evidence: In October 2023, we out-licensed the rights to motixafortide for all indications in substantially all of Asia and in November 2024, we out-licensed the global rights (other than in Asia) to motixafortide for all indications, other than solid tumors.

changes.text: In November 2024, the company out-licensed global rights to motixafortide for all indications other than solid tumors, and shut down independent U.S. commercialization activities.
